verdict.rationale: TaxJar's API reference lists official API clients for seven languages: Ruby, Python, PHP, Node, C#/.NET, Java and Go. The first-party taxjar-node GitHub repo backs this up with documented methods (createOrder, validateAddress, nexusRegions, VAT validate). Guides show how to set up the client and authenticate, and a sandbox endpoint supports safe development. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and evidence on maintenance status and feature coverage for the non-Node SDKs.
